description: We are a team of students passionate about science, technology, and space exploration. Our interests include physics, coding, artificial intelligence, data analysis, and graphic design. We aim to combine scientific knowledge with creative problem-solving to develop innovative solutions. We welcome teammates skilled in programming, web development, AI/ML, scientific research, data visualization, and graphic design who are eager to collaborate and contribute to our Martian Survival Guide.
summary:
Our project addresses the challenge of preparing future astronauts for human exploration of Mars by developing an interactive Martian exploration map. Since Mars has an extreme and unfamiliar environment, astronauts need accessible geographical information to understand the terrain, identify potential hazards, and make informed decisions before and during exploration.

Our solution presents Mars through an interactive mapping interface that allows users to explore different regions, examine surface features, visualize elevation profiles, and investigate geological characteristics. It also introduces an AI-powered assistant to help interpret geographical information and provide insights about selected locations.

By bringing planetary imagery, terrain exploration, and geological analysis together in one platform, our project aims to make complex Martian data easier to understand and more useful for future mission planning. Ultimately, we hope to contribute to safer, better-informed, and more sustainable human exploration of the Red Planet.
details:
Project Details

Our project is an interactive Martian mapping platform designed to help future astronauts explore and better understand the surface of Mars. It provides a visual environment where users can navigate different Martian regions, examine geographical features, and access information that could support future exploration and survival planning.

The platform is designed around several key features, including an interactive Mars map, location markers, terrain visualization, elevation profiles, geological exploration, and an AI-powered Geologist Assistant. These features aim to help users understand surface conditions, recognize potentially challenging terrain, and investigate locations that may be relevant to human exploration.

The project uses a Mars surface map as its primary visual foundation, transforming planetary imagery into an accessible exploration interface. We designed the user interface using Figma, focusing on a scientific dashboard layout with intuitive navigation, organized data panels, and clear visual indicators. No physical hardware is required for the current prototype.

What makes our approach creative is the combination of planetary mapping, geological exploration, and AI-assisted interpretation in one environment. Rather than presenting Mars as a static map, we aim to make it an interactive tool for discovering and understanding the planet.

Our main considerations include accessibility, usability, scientific relevance, visual clarity, and the challenges astronauts may encounter when navigating an unfamiliar planetary environment. Ultimately, the project aims to make Martian geographical information easier to explore and understand, contributing to better-informed decisions for future human missions to Mars.
